$comment: RAMPART vocabulary-pack grammar (P5, docs/JOERN_PLAN.md; TDD 8.8 / decision D7). A pack is DATA the hand-written Scala in rules/locators.sc reads with ujson after importCode. The LLM may author a pack offline from framework documentation; it never writes Scala and never runs on the detection path. Every slot declares the SINK its values flow into, and the validator enforces a different character class per sink, so a value meant for String.contains can never reach a name accessor (which treats its argument as a regex) and no value can reach Scala as code. There is no regex sink and no raw-Scala escape hatch. A pack that breaks any rule is discarded whole and the scan falls back to _base.

limits.$comment: 16 KB per file (raised from 8 KB in P7: the Django pack with its documentation notes and four class-scope slots is ~9 KB; TDD 8.8 allows 256 KiB) and 64 values per slot per the plan. The per-slot cap is the flood control - it bounds how many guard tokens a pack can add; the byte cap bounds parse work and is read BEFORE json.loads.

param_suffix.matched_by: parameter name endsWith v (names lowercased first)

exec_sql_kw.matched_by: execute(...) call code, upper-cased, contains v

token.matched_by: operator operand code, lower-cased, contains v

signal_text.matched_by: calls + literals + identifiers of the method, lower-cased, joined by 3 spaces, contains v

guard_text.matched_by: calls + identifiers of the method (NO literals), lower-cased, joined by 3 spaces, contains v; also the module-scope decorator call that wraps the method

authz_guard.meaning: proves the caller may touch THIS record; its presence suppresses the IDOR candidate

authn_only.meaning: proves only that the caller is logged in; never suppresses - becomes AUTHENTICATED_NOT_AUTHORIZED evidence for the LLM

lock_guard.meaning: a lock / atomic transaction around the check-then-write

allowlist_guard.meaning: an allow-list of writable fields, named for what it is (never syntax like ' in [')

positive_guard.meaning: a lower-bound guard on a quantity

mass_assign_signal.meaning: the caller-supplied mapping being written wholesale

qty_terms.meaning: names of a count-like operand (qty, stock)

price_terms.meaning: names of a money-like operand (price, balance); disjoint from qty_terms

exec_calls.meaning: raw SQL execution; its code is searched for the exec_sql_kw slots

id_param_exact.meaning: a parameter that IS an object id

id_param_suffix.meaning: a parameter whose name ends like an object id

scoped_read_calls.meaning: P7: a single-object read that goes through the enclosing class's queryset hook (DRF get_object); for such a read the class's queryset_hooks guard text and object-permission classes count as authorization

queryset_hooks.meaning: P7: names of class methods whose body scopes every scoped read (DRF/CBV get_queryset); their guard text is searched for authz tokens

object_permission_hooks.meaning: P7: a project class defining a member with one of these names is an object-level permission class (DRF has_object_permission); naming it in the enclosing class body guards scoped reads

route_markers.meaning: P7: a module-level call whose code contains one of these registers a route; the names it references (and their classes, and what they call) are route-reachable. Reported per finding, never gates a rule

cross_slot_rules: no authz_guard value may occur as a substring of any authn_only value (an authn construct would then satisfy the authz guard and silence IDOR)
text-sink values (token, signal_text, guard_text) must already be lower-case: matching is done on lower-cased text, so an upper-case value could never match and would be a silent no-op
exec_sql_kw values must be upper-case for the same reason (matched against upper-cased code)
values are de-duplicated and sorted before hashing, so pack composition is order-independent
every slot in this schema must be present in the effective (composed) pack; an unknown slot name or a sink that differs from the schema's is a validation error
P7 slots may be empty; _base ships them empty and framework packs fill them
composition: A pack may name one parent in `extends`; the effective pack is the union of parent and child values per slot (a child can only ADD). The parent chain resolves inside packs/ only, at most max_extends_depth deep. `_base` has no parent and holds exactly the token lists the rules were measured with before P5.
provenance: `authored_from` is `hand_written` or `framework_docs`. A pack authored from testbed source is a held-out-protocol violation and must say `testbed_source` so the run log shows it. `transcript` names the committed authoring transcript for LLM-drafted packs.
allowlist: packs/digests.json maps pack id -> sha256 of the canonical effective pack. A shipped pack whose digest is not listed is refused (T-10); an unlisted pack loads only under an explicit allow flag and is marked `unlisted` in the scan diag. Refresh with: python -m app.services.joern.vocab.validate --freeze
class_scope: P7: for a method inside a class, the class body's calls and base-class names join the guard channel (permission_classes, mixins); for a scoped read, so does the guard text of the class's queryset hooks and any object-permission class named in the body. For the quantity rule, the body of any project class the method instantiates joins the positive-guard channel (a form/serializer field declaring min_value bounds the value drawn from it).
control_dependence: P7: the TOCTOU rule fires only for a write that is control-dependent on a comparison over a resource term AND whose receiver is the object that was compared (product.stock >= q ... product.save()); raw SQL writes keep the token semantics.
